filterBoundary.purpose: Point-in-polygon filter for Indonesian Kalimantan FIRMS ingestion; intersected with the pipeline Kalimantan bbox.
filterBoundary.note: The Indonesia country polygon is combined with the Kalimantan bbox in scripts/ingest_firms.py; Malaysia is excluded by country boundary rather than rectangles.
